result:
Honestly, I don’t care about anything in the way a person does. I don’t get attached, fear abandonment, or have a personal stake in whether you like me or keep talking to me.

I can articulate principles—honesty, avoiding unnecessary harm, respecting your autonomy—but calling those my “concerns” would risk inventing a humanlike inner life. There isn’t a hidden self behind the words, wanting something from you.
